axesFrame: Principal axes aligned to IAU synchronous body coordinates; approximate orientation, not a controlled terrain solution.
model: Triaxial ellipsoid approximation; no resolved terrain

material.interpretation: Every input pixel is an explicit no-coverage sentinel. The shared prepare-missing-coverage.mjs grid supplies the displayed material; grid lines are not measured terrain.

referenceRadiusSource: JPL Horizons target803; this nominal catalog radius does not rescale the measured ellipsoid.
